Turn on Reading time in Settings and allow Pebble Desk in Usage access to see your log.

When you open a book in an e-book app, it goes to the top of your reading list. Only book titles, authors, progress, due dates and covers on the shelf and search screens, and the title and progress on the reading screen, are read; book text and other apps are never seen. Turn on Pebble Desk in Accessibility.
Accessibility may still show Pebble Desk as On (or \"Not working\"), but it has stopped running. Books you open won\'t be added, and reading time won\'t be tied to a book.
Turn Pebble Desk Off, then On again in Accessibility to restart it.
Turn Pebble Desk Off, then On again in Accessibility. If this message comes back, auto-add doesn\'t work on this device. Tap Don\'t show again and add your books yourself with Add a book.

This happens when BOOX freezes and unfreezes Pebble Desk. Turn off freezing for Pebble Desk in BOOX Settings › Apps and Notifications › Freeze Settings, then turn Pebble Desk Off and On again in Accessibility.
Books you open in e-book apps won\'t be added, and reading time won\'t know which book it was. Turn on Pebble Desk in Accessibility.
Pebble Desk\'s screen DPI has been changed to %1$d. Everything looks larger and part of the home screen won\'t fit.\n\nTo fix: set Pebble Desk\'s DPI to %2$d in the device settings.

Use list view for the shelf. Cover view shows no titles, so books come in only when you open the menu while reading.
After opening a book, tap the middle once to open the menu. The Kyobo eBook shelf cannot be read.

Open books from the recent list or the bookshelf list (list or grid view). Covers come only from these two. Books opened from the Home tab\'s recent row or the bookshelf view come in without a cover when you open the menu while reading.
Open books by tapping them in the EzViewer file list. Files opened from other apps do not come in.
